ground_ice.unit: Not scored (filter only: summer thaw depth <= 0.5 m where CCI knows it). Earth: thaw depth [m] and ground temperature of this Depth Layer [K]. Mars: SWIM ice consistency of this Depth Layer (context)

dryness.unit: ranked among cells that passed the filters, driest = 1; wet_summer = SMAP surface wetness (fraction of saturation)
